assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

A service-hosted 2.x session idles in ready between turns, bound to the live service pid. Within the daemon's ready TTL (30 min by default) nothing removes it: the watcher emits a removal only for an archived or missing row (watcher_v2.go v2SessionGone), and the pid stays alive. The next prompt's activity drives it back to working on the same ses_… id (watcher_v2.go reads only rows past the session's cursor as activity).

## Not tested: past the TTL

The scenario's V1 recordings ran with the default TTL (no IRRLICHT_READY_SESSION_TTL), and so does this one: 20s idle, well under 30 min — the record's 'as-is'. A shortened TTL would NOT keep this session: opencode declares SessionHostArgv (agent.go) and no ReleasedPID, so pid_manager's idlesOnHost lets the TTL reap an idle root on a live service on purpose. Measured: P3's QA run 2 (`/Users/factory/.oc2sb/qa/pr2114-p3-ttl`) saw ready sessions on the live service pid 12420 disappear at the TTL. That is the designed end of an abandoned service-hosted session (1-2's TTL variant), not a defect of this cell.

## Spec choices

- Turn 1's hook-ended ready holds for at least 15s of the 20s idle, with no transcript_removed and no process_exited on the session in that window.
- Turn 2 starts on the same ses_… id and ends on its own Stop hook.
caveats: Run with the daemon's default ready TTL, as V1's 1-3 was; 'past readyTTL' is not exercised (see Reasoning: the TTL reaps an idle service-hosted root by design, measured in P3's QA run 2).

sources.note: 2.x reader: lists session_v2 rows with time_archived IS NULL; a session is admitted on its first session_message activity while a service is up (#2107); an archived or missing row emits EventRemoved (v2SessionGone)
servicePIDFor: a session no client runs binds to the one running service; OwnsSharedPID answers false for an archived row
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)

HandleProcessExit/HandleWatcherExit: every session bound to an exited pid gets process_exited and is deleted, children first; idlesOnHost lets the ready TTL reap an idle root on a live session host (opencode SessionHostArgv)
P3 QA run 2 with a short IRRLICHT_READY_SESSION_TTL: ready sessions on the live service pid 12420 were removed at the TTL

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
One turn, 20s idle in ready, then a second turn on the same session

script.text: Reply with exactly the word: ok
Reply with exactly the word: alive

verify: turn 1 ends in ready on the plugin's Stop hook
the session stays ready through 20s of idle — no removal, no process exit
turn 2 drives working → ready on the SAME ses_… id
